name: Accounting (Small Business)
tagline: A friendly template for bookkeeping & tax practices — take bookings from day one.
description: A warm, friendly small-business accounting site — a fresh teal palette, a coral accent and a clean, approachable look. Installs a working booking flow: three accountants you book by name, and a real menu of consultations (a free consult, bookkeeping, payroll, quarterly taxes, new-business setup). Ships as "Ledger & Co.", the everyday bookkeeping & tax practice for freelancers and small businesses.
